title: relay metrics has no time window
what: Add a time window (`--since 6h|1d|<date>`, `--until`) and a bucket option (`--by hour|day|week`, default week) to the `relay metrics` summary, so stage medians, gate time and cost per unit can be compared across buckets.
why: The owner asked for stage and gate times over the last hours and expected the metrics command to answer; it groups only by ISO week, so "the last few hours" cannot be asked. Its absence from `relay help` is item every-new-relay-command-edits-bin-relay.
failing_case: 30 Oct 2026: `bin/relay metrics` prints only "2026-W44:" with one block for the whole week; no option narrows it to hours.
pass_cases: `relay metrics --since 12h --by hour` prints one block per hour with per-stage median and total, gate time, cost per unit; an empty hour prints a line saying so.
An unknown option is refused with the usage line, not a traceback.

said: Я полагал что ты воспользуешься встроенным механизмом metrics, он должен отвечать на эти вопросы, он был введен совсем недавно и мне было интересно как он работает
